verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote, attribution and logo readable with a clean left axis, but the can is shrunk to a tiny icon (its SOLSTICE label can't be read) inside a small circle that floats in the corner, and the area to the right of the quote is left empty. In B the quote is larger, but the attribution 'THE ULTRA TASTING TEAM' is shrunk to an unreadable few pixels, the big purple circle crowds up under the end of the quote lines, and the can and footer feel jammed into the bottom edge.
